layer_1_style.description: High-poly 3D animation style, cinematic CGI, smooth clay textures, soft studio lighting, tactile 'handmade' feel.

layer_3_action.subject: Marine herbivore diet symbolism
features: A stylized, cartoonish bundle of marine sea lettuce and kelp fronds made of smooth clay
The leaves are thick, wavy vibrant green clay gathered neatly together at a stubby base
Soft, undulating ribbon shapes with rounded edges to maintain a toy-like, friendly aesthetic
Soft studio lighting with gentle highlights
layer_3_action.action: A clean, centered shot of a clay marine plant cluster sitting on a simple clay surface. The background is a soft, neutral out-of-focus color. The image is designed as a clear icon or symbol to indicate an algae/plant-eating diet for a children's matching game. No text.
